comparison_policy: same original year and GWNO cohort, later edition truncated to origin, same target horizon
limitations: This is a retrospective replay of the exact preregistered Markov formula using UCDP 23.1,24.1,25.1,26.1 original source bytes. Forecasts for historical origins were NOT issued at the time. Some historical country-year source labels may be revised, including global transition counts and cohort composition. The six pairs overlap source editions, historical years and countries and are NOT six independent trials. No future target label or first public 2025-origin forecast changes. The source timestamp is public metadata, not independent notarization. Deterministic top20 boundary ties are broken by GWNO numeric ID; these are NOT meaningful confidence differences. No inference that 27.1 will resemble these revisions or that GEO2028 will perform at a particular level.
